title: EAS Payments (engine-first slice)
description: A learning/prototype vertical slice of the EAS Payments Engine on Snapback: a store notification triggers an action, the action re-fetches authoritative transaction state from a fake local store over ctx.fetch with a granted ctx.secrets credential, and commits through one mutation; entitlementGrants — the derived read model — backs the live query the app gates on. A cron sweep expires closed subscription windows through the same action -> mutation split.

backend.stalenessPolicy: committed review manifest; regenerate with codegen under SNAPBACK_OUTBOUND_ACTIONS=1 (the opt-in is a codegen input and changes inputsHash); freshness tracked by artifacts.json inputsHash

headless.toolchain: node>=22 (built-in fetch); cargo to build/run the local server; the suite starts its own fake store

headless: health reports a local ibex+sqlite target
generated references load: query, mutation, action, cron
deterministic reset + declarative seed installs the catalog
getEntitlements returns pro, active, for that user
entitlements are user-scoped: a non-buyer holds nothing
the transaction carries store, status, and environment
replaying the receipt is idempotent end to end
the store, not the caller, decides the environment
a store-reported expired receipt grants nothing
a bad store credential fails the action and writes nothing
a live subscriber sees a purchase land in realtime
the expireGrants cron job is declared against the sweep action
a grant past activeUntil flips off on a scheduler tick
an ordinary query is honestly reported as NOT live

notClaiming: real store validation — validateReceipt performs a real outbound fetch, but against a fake local store fixture, not Apple/Google/Stripe, and with no signature or JWS verification
production auth — the slice runs in dev auth mode; sessions mode is out of scope
the re-fetch-on-notification path — applyStoreState is a later slice
metering or billing — transactions carry an environment tag so sandbox rows can be excluded later, and nothing consumes it yet
